scenes.description: Choosing A or An Fruit at the Picnic Table
Benny and Kid Sharing Both Toy Cars on the Rug
Gathering All and Every Book neatly on the Wooden Shelf

character_line.en: Here is our picnic fruit basket! What would you like to eat?
character_line.zh: 這是我們的野餐水果籃！你想吃什麼呢？

options.en: I want an apple and a sweet banana!
options.zh: 我想要一顆蘋果和一根香甜的香蕉！

options.hint: 注意母音開頭用「an apple」，子音用「a banana」喔！
挑選水果說「an apple and a banana」給 Benny 聽喔！

character_line.en: An apple and a banana! Can I also have an orange?
character_line.zh: 一顆蘋果和一根香蕉！我也能吃一顆柳橙嗎？

options.en: Sure! Here is an orange for you!

options.hint: 柳橙 orange 是母音開頭，說「an orange」喔！
大方地分給 Benny 一顆柳橙吧！

character_line.en: Look at these two cool toy cars on the rug! Which one do you like?
character_line.zh: 看地毯上這兩輛酷炫的玩具車！你喜歡哪一輛？

options.en: I like both of the cars! They are fast!
options.zh: 兩輛我都喜歡！它們都跑好快！

options.hint: 告訴 Benny 兩台車你都很喜歡「both of the cars」！

character_line.en: Both of them! Let's race together across the rug!
character_line.zh: 兩輛都喜歡！那我們在地毯上一決勝負賽車吧！

options.en: Ready, set, go! Both cars are zooming!
options.zh: 各就各位，預備，跑！兩台車都飛快奔馳！

options.hint: 興奮地喊「Ready, set, go!」開始賽車吧！
形容兩輛車一起衝刺「Both cars...」喔！

character_line.en: Playtime is over! What should we do with all these storybooks?
character_line.zh: 遊戲時間結束了！我們該怎麼處理所有這些故事書呢？

options.en: Let's put all the books on the shelf!
options.zh: 我們把所有的書都放回書架上吧！

options.hint: 整理全部的書可以用「all the books」喔！
提議把所有書整齊擺回架子上吧！

character_line.en: Every book is in its place now! Our room looks so tidy!
character_line.zh: 每一本書現在都在它的位置上了！我們的房間看起來好整潔！

options.en: Yes! Every corner is clean and neat!
options.zh: 沒錯！每一個角落都乾淨又整齊！

options.hint: 形容每一個角落可以用「Every corner」喔！
跟 Benny 一起讚美整理好的整齊房間吧！
